meta.name: archify
meta.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technical workflows, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data lineage, state machines, or to convert/beautify Mermaid.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把系统结构与流程变成清晰直观的图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要把系统结构画出来给团队评审或留档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn system structures and flows into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to visualize system structure for team review or documentation.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的文字需求或粘贴的 Mermaid 图，做成一份自包含的 HTML 图（架构、流程、时序、数据流、状态机），内联 SVG、明暗主题可切换，可导出 PNG、JPEG、SVG 等格式，先校验通过再交付。
howto.when: 当你要求可视化系统架构、API 调用时序、状态机等图表，或把粘贴的 Mermaid 流程图、时序图、状态图转换或美化时触发。

say.text: 把这个系统的架构画成一张可交互的 HTML 图
say.note: 先生成候选 JSON，校验通过再交付

say.text: 把这段 Mermaid 时序图转成 archify 图并美化
say.note: 按拓扑重画，不照搬 Mermaid 样式

say.text: 给这张图加上流动动画并导出 PNG
say.note: 动画只在你明确要求时才开启

howto.what_en: Claude turns your request or pasted Mermaid into a self-contained HTML diagram (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle) with inline SVG, dark/light themes and PNG/JPEG/SVG/WebM export, validated first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to visualize system architecture, API call sequences, state machines, or to convert or beautify pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, or stateDiagram input.

say_en.text: Draw this system's architecture as an interactive HTML diagram
say_en.note: Generates a JSON candidate, validates, then delivers HTML

say_en.text: Convert this Mermaid sequence diagram into an archify diagram
say_en.note: Topology is re-authored; Mermaid styling is not copied

say_en.text: Add flow animation to this diagram and export it as PNG
say_en.note: Motion is only enabled when you ask for it
